purpose: Mobile-first Main Menu / Command Hub runtime foundation with implemented first-launch Awakening onboarding, canon starter Titan binding, save validation, campaign handoff, art scale references, enemy archetype registry, mission tactical profiles, Titan/Faction Trials, raid economy, and battlefield entry.

recommendationService.name: getNextRecommendedAction
rules: claim pending reward before next mission
select a valid Titan if selectedTitanIds are missing
enter elite only when campaign unlock rule is true
show locked reason for future PvP

unlockLogic.elite: Unlocked after all Normal missions for current faction are completed.
unlockLogic.arena: Unlocked after first chapter is cleared and async arena snapshot contract is implemented.
unlockLogic.futurePvp: Locked: future networking layer; never presented as implemented.
unlockLogic.developerTools: Visible only when developer mode is true.

artDirection.style: premium mythological tactical RPG, mobile-first, dark, monumental Gates, enormous Titans, atmospheric fog, particles, cel-shaded influence where appropriate
artDirection.fallbackPolicy: Use canon-safe placeholder if canonical visual data is missing; never invent lore.

performanceRules: preload only boot/title/hub/current realm/current selected Titan assets
avoid full menu re-render for resource-only updates
qualityGates: Command Hub route is the first rendered game route after title/startup.

Resource bar maps PlayerState resources only.
Every bottom nav button routes to a real implemented screen or LockedContentPanel.
getNextRecommendedAction resolves a real mission handoff.
Startup save validation never silently overwrites corrupt data.
Command Hub smoke completes BOOT -> LOAD -> HUB -> TITANS -> BACK -> BATTLE -> RETURN -> HUB.

antiPayToWinRules: Starter choice is canon-safe and limited to three roles.
Full roster is hidden during onboarding to prevent roster flood.
Second Titan desire is created through trials and story, not mandatory purchase pressure.
Trial Favor persists; borrowed gear does not.
No shop currency, PvP rating, raid tokens, or uncapped materials from trials.
First-showcase rewards are stronger than repeats to avoid farming loops.
Best scores inform recommendations, not hard locks.

missionTacticalProfiles.rule: Mission recommendations surface tactical advantages only; any valid active Titan can attempt the mission.

creatureBehaviorRuntime.rule: Creature difficulty must be readable through telegraphed behavior and counterplay before damage or objective denial resolves.

enemyArchetypeRegistry.rule: Enemy difficulty comes from readable AI, composition, hazards, and phases before raw stat inflation.

artDirectorScaleSheets.rule: Scale references enlarge Gates, architecture, and battlefield space instead of shrinking Titans.

implementedOptimizations: partial resource-bar refresh for reward claims
rules: Full route renders are measured and logged when they exceed budget.
Resource-only reward claims update visible resource amounts without forcing a full menu rebuild.
Visible asset preloads are counted and use cached asset lookups.
FINAL assets are selected through AssetManager.resolvedPath.
Fallbacks remain available and visible to QA.
Art status badges appear in Command Hub and Gates screens.
